Definition: The availability and presence of major cloud service providers (hyperscale and regional) operating in or serving the country with local or near-local infrastructure. Cloud availability determines access to scalable computing resources for government, business, and startups.
Value Name: Served remotely from distant regions only (>100ms latency)
redteam_note: Scored >0 but NO source cited — unsupported claim, verify first. No data year recorded — provenance/recency unknown.
revision_notes: No source was originally cited. Verified (2025-2026) that no hyperscale or regional cloud availability zone exists in or near Liberia: AWS's nearest African region is af-south-1 (Cape Town, South Africa), and Google Cloud/Azure likewise have no West African region; Liberia's only listed data centre (MTN Monrovia) is a telecom facility, not a cloud/colocation site. This confirms Liberia is served remotely from distant regions only. Value code 2 confirmed, not changed.

Definition: The size and vibrancy of the local software developer and technology professional community. Measured through proxies such as GitHub activity, Stack Overflow representation, local tech meetup groups, and developer surveys. Indicates the country's capacity to build and maintain digital systems locally.
Value Name: Emerging (small but growing community, <1,000 active developers)
redteam_note: Scored >0 but NO source cited — unsupported claim, verify first. No data year recorded — provenance/recency unknown.
revision_notes: No source was originally cited. Verified evidence of a small, organised but growing developer community: GDG Monrovia (Google Developer Group), Innovations Hub Liberia coding bootcamps, RHOTEL Digital & Innovation Hub, and BlueCrest University Liberia's IT programme (2020-2025), plus individual developers visible on GitHub/LinkedIn. GitHub's Innovation Graph does not publish a developer count for Liberia because it falls below the platform's 100-developer quarterly reporting threshold, corroborating a small (well under 1,000) but existing community. Value code 2 (Emerging) confirmed, not changed.
